DSH Mobile is a local engine shell for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) on Android: it runs the full Node.js agent engine inside the phone\'s sandbox — no server, no cloud; data never leaves the device.
Built on the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent framework, open-sourced by DeepSeek in Aug 2026

Let other devices on the same Wi-Fi open this agent in a browser

The engine will switch from listening on this phone only to listening on every network interface. Any device on the same LAN can then open the address below in a browser and use this agent — no need to touch this phone.

Please note:
· Anyone who has the address can drive it — it reads/writes files, runs commands, and spends your model API budget
· Only enable this on a network you trust (home Wi-Fi, your own hotspot)
· Never enable it on public, corporate, or guest Wi-Fi

You can turn it off here at any time; that immediately goes back to local-only.

Open http://IP:3080/ directly on the same network — no token in the URL

Any device that can reach port 3080 on this phone will then be able to use this agent — with no credential at all.
That means it can read and write files on this phone, run commands, and spend your model API budget.
· Enable it only on your own home Wi-Fi or your own hotspot · Keep it off on public, corporate, or guest networks · Turning the switch back off restores token-protected access
The address becomes a clean URL without a token, easy to type.

Give every model a reasoning-effort selector (hand-declared models have none by default)
Enable reasoning effort for all models?

Models that do not declare their thinking levels (all hand-declared ones) currently show no effort selector at all. Turning this on gives them low / medium / high plus off.
This changes what gets sent to the provider: if a provider rejects the parameter, requests that pick a level will fail — switching that model back to off restores it.
If you only use providers that already declare their levels, you do not need this.
